section_summary.extract_value: This introduction discusses the prevalence and impact of breast size dissatisfaction in women, reviews existing measurement tools and their limitations, and introduces the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS) developed by Swami et al. (2015). The present study aims to examine the psychometric properties of the BSRS in a sample of Brazilian women, noting that correlations with body appreciation and BMI will be assessed.
